name: AllDebrid sign-in
description: Signs an AllDebrid account in with a PIN, without an API key being typed here.

codes.alldebrid_auth.consent_denied: The provider refused the sign-in for this account.
codes.alldebrid_auth.sign_in_refused: The provider refused the sign-in. Start it again.
codes.alldebrid_auth.bad_reply: The provider sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.alldebrid_auth.flow_expired: The PIN expired before it was confirmed.
